title: GLM provider is Claude-compatible alias
content: The `glm` bro provider is Claude-compatible, not a separate protocol surface. It uses the Claude CLI transport and Claude model/effort surface, with a Z.AI-backed Claude config root (`.claude-zai`) selected via `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`.
rationale: Z.AI documents their Claude tool as a Claude Code setup with backend model mapping via Anthropic-compatible env/settings. Exposing a fake GLM-native CLI surface in bro orchestration would diverge from the harness users actually run. Keeping the surface Claude-shaped preserves working argv, session, MCP, and filter behavior while allowing Z.AI account routing behind the scenes.
